name: Tiles (swagger)

name: Blackjack
description: 6-deck shoe with cut card, dealer stands on soft 17, 3:2 naturals, insurance, double, split to 4 hands, late surrender, dealer peek, basic-strategy hints.
testing: tests/casino.test.ts

name: European roulette
description: Single-zero wheel in real order; straight, split, street, corner, line, dozens, columns and even-money bets.
testing: tests/casino.test.ts

name: Video poker (Jacks or Better 9/6)
description: Full paytable, hold/draw, exact hand evaluation.
testing: tests/casino.test.ts

name: Kiwi Gold pokie
description: Weighted reels with an exactly computed 92.54% return to player.
testing: tests/casino.test.ts

name: Driving
description: Get into parked cars (or carjack), drive with WASD, horn, crash and get out.
testing: tests/city.test.ts drivers

name: Cash, shops and pawning
description: Buy food, toys and weapons with NZD; pawn valuables at 45%.
testing: tests/city.test.ts money and barter

name: Barter
description: Trade items with NPCs who weigh value, likes, friendship and greed and can counter-offer.
testing: tests/city.test.ts money and barter

name: Bandages
description: Bandage yourself or others to stop bleeding.
testing: tests/city.test.ts injuries

name: Lane traffic
description: Left-hand lanes, traffic lights, braking for people and cars, turns and U-turns, towing of abandoned cars.
testing: tests/city.test.ts traffic

name: Police response
description: Witnessed crimes are called in; cops chase, taser, arrest, escort to the station and jail.
testing: tests/city.test.ts crime

name: Wanted stars
description: Up to 5 stars from witnessed crimes; they fade when cops lose sight of you; getting busted costs a fine.
testing: tests/city.test.ts crime

name: Muggings and theft
description: Thieves pickpocket, shoplift, rob tills and mug at knifepoint.
testing: tests/city.test.ts crime

name: Graffiti and clean-up
description: Taggers paint building faces; cleaners scrub illegal tags; Bando Alley wall is legal.
testing: tests/city.test.ts crime

name: Wounds and fake blood
description: Wounds by body part at three levels; head shots spray, gashes drip, bandages show; cartoon only and can be turned off.
testing: tests/city.test.ts injuries

name: Bleeding and collapse
description: Open wounds drain blood; low blood causes collapse; paramedics or an ambulance take people to hospital. Nobody dies.
testing: tests/city.test.ts injuries

name: Attraction, flirting and dating
description: Characters have who they fancy, flirt, ask each other out, go on dates and go home together (off screen).
testing: tests/city.test.ts romance

name: Affairs and getting caught
description: Seen kisses become gossip; partners find out, argue, break up or fight.
testing: tests/city.test.ts romance

name: MosaicScope bookings
description: Regulars book shoots at the real price list; the crew shoots them on location.
testing: tests/city.test.ts MosaicScope

name: Crew plugs real posts
description: The Mosaics bring up real Instagram posts and point you to follow and book.
testing: tests/social.test.ts dialogue

name: MosaicScope FM
description: The SoundCloud playlist plays as the city radio from your first click.
testing: e2e/smoke.mjs

name: Unique faces
description: Every character gets a distinct face, hair, hat, build and colour combination.
testing: tests/city.test.ts

name: Sensible unique names
description: Full names from a NZ name book, no repeats; nicknames for the crew.
testing: tests/city.test.ts

name: City state in saves
description: Cars, graffiti, tills, crime records and bookings are saved (schema v4, migrates older saves).
testing: tests/persistence.test.ts
